response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves treatment for an acute injury (ankle sprain) that occurred during a trip. Clause A4.1 covers medical treatment, including outpatient care and prescribed medication, resulting from an acute illness or injury during travel. There is no indication that the injury was pre-existing (A5.1 would apply if it were), and the treatment was necessary and appropriate."}
